scope: Five selected research sources from the 13 November editorial screening.

deduplication.method: DOI, PMID where available and distinctive title or species terms searched in tracked public main text
deduplication.scope_limit: Other branches, private data and the live search index were outside this check.

records.title: The ‘dark magic mushroom’ co-produces amatoxins and psilocybin
records.discovery_method: Focused PubMed query modelled on the portal’s publication-date search
records.summary: Mass spectrometry identified psilocybin and amatoxins in Galerina indica.
records.limitations: Species-specific finding. The journal version and July preprint represent the same work.

records.title: Psychedelic ego-dissolution: a philosophical and qualitative critique
records.journal: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B
records.discovery_method: Focused PubMed query modelled on the portal’s publication-date search
records.design: Philosophical critique and qualitative thematic analysis of 411 reports
records.summary: The authors interpret some descriptions of 5-MeO-DMT ego dissolution as compatible with minimal self-consciousness.
records.limitations: Retrospective, self-selected reports, including some with co-use. The interpretation cannot establish the contents of consciousness independently.

records.title: Changes in wellbeing, self-compassion and alexithymia in a proof of principle trial with MDMA-assisted therapy for major depressive disorder
records.discovery_method: Focused PubMed query modelled on the portal’s publication-date search
records.design: Open-label, uncontrolled follow-up analysis of 12 adults
records.summary: Participants reported higher self-compassion after MDMA-assisted therapy and at follow-up.
records.limitations: Small sample, self-report and no comparator. MDMA, psychotherapy and expectancy effects cannot be isolated.

records.title: Stimulus-specific recruitment of human amygdala neurons predicts episodic memory encoding success
records.design: Human single-neuron recordings during a visual episodic memory task
records.summary: Activity in category-selective amygdala neurons predicted later remembering of visual items.
records.limitations: Predictive association within a specific task. Generalisation to other senses and causal necessity remain open.

records.title: 5-HT2A receptors in layer 5 pyramidal neurons mediate the neuroplastic but not the hallucinogenic effects of psilocybin
records.design: Mouse experiments with cell-type-specific receptor manipulation
records.summary: Layer 5 pyramidal neuron 5-HT2A signalling was necessary and sufficient for the measured remodelling and dispensable for head-twitch behaviour.
records.limitations: The head-twitch response is a rodent proxy. Human subjective, clinical and microdosing effects remain untested in this study.

research_policy.summary: Up to US$4.9 million for development work that can support future trials.
